Run & Bun AI integration
-------------------------
CobbleServerTools RC21 embeds a relocated copy of the loader-agnostic Run & Bun AI common classes
from the user-supplied rbrctai Fabric artifact. Its fabric.mod.json identifies the project as
"Cobblemon Run and Bun AI", author "Surilexa", license "MIT", mod id "rbrctai".
Fabric entrypoint classes and Fabric metadata are not used as a CobbleServerTools runtime dependency.
The classes are relocated under net.cobbleservertools.compat.rct.runbun to avoid collisions.
